marker.description: Green paint mark on the tip of the mandibular condyle

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the green paint mark.
main_explanation: The green paint is located on the superior aspect of the mandibular ramus, specifically on the articular surface known as the condyle, which articulates with the mandibular fossa of the temporal bone.

supporting_question.question: Which nerve provides the primary sensory innervation to the temporomandibular joint?
supporting_question.explanation: The auriculotemporal nerve, a branch of the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve (V3), provides the main sensory innervation to the temporomandibular joint.
